description: Anomaly Power System Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yasser AbdelSatar. "This dataset provides a labelled time series of low-voltage electrical measurements for developing and benchmarking power-quality anomaly detection methods. It contains 1,300 samples recorded at 1 Hz over approximately 22 minutes on a nominal 230 V \/ 50 Hz single-phase system. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
